title: Major disaster declared: Tropical Storm Klaus, Virgin Islands of the U.S. (DR-729)
summary: FEMA major disaster declaration for Virgin Islands of the U.S. (hurricane), declared 1984-12-10.

title: SEALCO AIR CONTROLS, INC.: LIGHTING:FLASHER:TURN SIGNAL (50,000 affected)
summary: TURN SIGNALS FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 108, LAMPS, REFLECTIVE DEVICES AND ASSOCIATED EQUIPMENT. THESE TURN SIGNALS DO NOT MEET THE DURABILITY REQUIREMENT (200 HOURS), NOR THE FLASH RATE REQUIREMENT (15 SECS. ON AND 15 SECS. OFF).

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES:MARKINGS (381 affected)
summary: TIRES INCORRECTLY LABELED TUBELESS ON SIDE WALL ALTHOUGH TUBE TYPE APPEARS ON PAPER LABEL.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: FUEL:THROTTLE LINKAGES AND CONTROL (2,639 affected)
summary: DISPLACEMENT OF THE FUEL HOSE DURING ASSEMBLY. AT OR NEAR FULL THROTTLE, A ROLLER ON THE FAST IDLE ARM OF THE THROTTLE LINKAGE CAN CATCH BEHIND ONE OF THE FUEL LINES, CAUSING THE THROTTLE TO STICK WIDE OPEN.

title: KELSEY-HAYES COMPANY: BRAKES:ELECTRIC:ACTUATING ASSEMBLY:MAGNET (113 affected)
summary: OPEN ELECTRICAL CIRCUIT IN WIRE SUPPLYING CURRENT WHICH ACTIVATES THE ELECTRIC BRAKES IS CAUSED BY FATIGUE OF LEAD WIRE.

title: WESTERN STAR TRUCKS, INC.: LIGHTING:SWITCH:BUTTON:RING:OTHER PART LIGHTING SY (516 affected)
summary: A DEFECTIVE TOGGLE SWITCH MAY HAVE BEEN INSTALLED IN THE SLEEPER OF SOME TRUCKS. THE PROBLEM MAY CAUSE AN INTERMITTENT SHORT CIRCUIT, RESULTING FROM CONSTANT VIBRATION OF THE VEHICLE WHICH MAY CAUSE THE SWITCH TERMINAL TO WEAR THROUGH THE INSULATING MATERIAL.

title: DOLPHIN RV PRODUCTS INC.: WHEELS:MULTIPLE:LUGS:NUTS:BOLTS (100 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE DUAL WHEEL ASSEMBLIES WERE PROVIDED WITH FORD WHEEL CENTERS WHICH DO NOT SEAT PROPERLY ON TOYOTA BRAKE DRUMS. THIS IS DUE TO A MACHINE SCREW WHICH PROTRUDES FROM THE DRUM. THE MISMATING OF WHEELS WITH BRAKE DRUMS CAN CAUSE STRESS CRACKING AROUND THE MOUNTING LUGS.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): ENGINE:OTHER PARTS (6,755 affected)
summary: THE ENGINE OIL PRESSURE SENDING UNIT MAY DEVELOP AN OIL LEAK.

title: FOUR WHEEL CAMPERS INC.: EQUIPMENT:CENTER OF GRAVITY INDICATOR LABEL (5,155 affected)
summary: LABELS TO IDENTIFY PROPER PLACEMENT OF JACKS WHEN LOADING AND UNLOADING THE CAMPER ARE NOT PROVIDED AS REQUIRED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 126, TRUCK CAMPER LOADING.

title: UNITED TRADE REP(TOMOS): MANUFACTURER'S INFORMATION TO DEALERS (44,643 affected)
summary: FAILURE TO CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 119, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS. LOAD RANGE DESIGNATION (A) IS MISSING FROM SIDE WALL. CONSUMER INFORMATION CONCERNING BRAKING DISTANCE WAS NOT INCLUDED WITH OWNER"S MANUAL, AS SPECIFIED IN FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 575.101.

title: Yokohama Tire Corporation: TIRES:PLY (1,301 affected)
summary: NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES. A SEPARATION MAY DEVELOP BETWEEN THE PLIES IN THE LOWER SIDE WALL AREA OF THE TIRE, POSSIBLY RESULTING IN A SUDDEN LOSS OF AIR.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: STEERING:LINKAGES:LINK:DRAG:CONNECTION (10,938 affected)
summary: SOME DRAG LINK PARTS CAN SEPARATE FROM THE ASSEMBLY WHICH CONNECTS STEERING GEAR PITMAN ARM TO THE FRONT AXLE STEERING ARM.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:SHOE AND DRUM SYSTEM:DRUM (41 affected)
summary: UNDER EXTREME CONDITIONS, ONE OR BOTH REAR BRAKE DRUMS MAY UNEXPECTEDLY CRACK, CREATING AN UNBALANCED BRAKING CONDITION.

title: TRW Automotive, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (2,123 affected)
summary: REAR OF PLASTIC SHELL MAY CRACK OR SHEAR ALLOWING THE SHOULDER HARNESS TO LOOSEN AND OCCUPANT TO FALL FORWARD MORE THAN THE DISTANCE PERMITTED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 213, CHILD RESTRAINT SYSTEMS.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:AIR SUSPENSION SYSTEM (15 affected)
summary: A POORLY DESIGNED BRACKET WHICH MOUNTS THE SERVICE/PARKING BRAKE UNIT TO THE REAR DRIVE AXLE MAY ALLOW DAMAGE TO BRAKE CHAMBER. DAMAGE MAY CAUSE THE SPRING BRAKE TO BE APPLIED.

title: PETERBILT MOTOR COMPANY: STRUCTURE:FRAME:MEMBERS AND BODY:TRUCK (877 affected)
summary: THE WELD BETWEEN THE GRABHANDLE AND MOUNTING PLATE MAY FAIL, CAUSING GRABHANDLE TO COME OFF UNEXPECTEDLY.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT BELTS:LAP:FRONT (208 affected)
summary: REQUIRED FRONT CENTER SEAT BELT ASSEMBLY WAS OMITTED. VEHICLES ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 209, SEAT BELT ASSEMBLIES.

title: U-HAUL: TIRES:MARKINGS (920 affected)
summary: TIRES DO NOT MEET FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS (REQUIRING STRENGTH RATING TO BE BRANDED ON SIDE WALLS.) THIS LACK OF INFORMATION CAN RESULT IN INADVERTENT OVERLOADING OF THE VEHICLE.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:ELECTRICAL:LINE:HOSE (246 affected)
summary: METAL BURRS AND SHARP EDGES ON FUEL RAILS MAY HAVE DAMAGED ADJACENT O-RING SEALS DURING ASSEMBLY. THE DEFECT COULD CAUSE FUEL LEAKAGE WHEN ENGINE IS OPERATING.

title: Redundant JAGUAR ROVER TRIUMPH INC.: TIRES:SIDEWALL (675 affected)
summary: PIN HOLE (ONE 16TH INCH IN DIAMETER) IS LOCATED IN LOWER SIDE WALL AREA ON THE BLACK SIDE WALL SIDE OF THE TIRE. THE HOLE WAS CAUSED BY A BROKEN VENT DRILL BIT THAT WAS LEFT IN THE TIRE MOLD DURING MANUFACTURE OF THE TIRE.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:WIRING:HARNESS:FRONT:UNDERHOOD (177,587 affected)
summary: WIRE IN BATTERY CHARGING CIRCUIT CANNOT TOLERATE THE MAXIMUM CURRENT DRAWN BY THE ALTERNATOR. UNDER REPEATED HIGH ELECTRICAL LOAD, HEAT WILL BUILD UP AT CONNECTOR TERMINAL AREA, MELTING THE PLASTIC WIRE HARNESS, POSSIBLY DISCHARGING BATTERY.
